name: SillyTavern
description: LLM Frontend for Power Users — a unified interface for many LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, KoboldAI, NovelAI, and more) with visual novel mode, world/lorebook support, image generation integration, TTS, and extensive customization.

notes.text: SillyTavern requires a modern browser with JavaScript enabled. No built-in authentication — restrict access via network or reverse proxy.
User data (characters, worlds, settings) is stored in /opt/sillytavern/data/.
